page.layout: One printed page: running head centred at top with page number at right; main text in one column; handwritten marginal annotations at the right edge (not printed, not transcribed); fragments of the facing page at the left edge (not transcribed).

main_text.p: Imperator Fridericus, etiamsi non multa gesit in armis:tamen fuit sapiēs,nouit modum sui imperij et regni,ac in omni uita sapiēter imperiū rexit.
Casimirus rex Polonicus, iustus & excellens uictor.
Rex Mathias Vngarius,asperior aliquantulum, at utilis in armis.
Ioannes Hunniades,præstans princeps,&egregius post Mathiam rex Vngariæ,&c.
In Germania Carolus Burgundus,pater Philippi Burgundi,qui est nominatus Bonus:à quo Maximilianus filius etiam Bonus dictus, qui propter multas excellentes uirtutes ualde fuit dilectus in Burgundia.
Marchio Albertus,qui nominatus est Achilles Germanicus,ualuit consilio,prudentia,& alijs uirtutibus. Albertus dux Saxoniæ.
Sic considerate,quòd Deus semper dederit & dat aliquos bonos et salutares principes,quorũ gubernatio et regimen imperijs est felix & salutaris.
main_text.head: Leo imago boni gubernatoris.
main_text.p: Sicut leo uenatur lupos, sic ordinaria imperia & gubernatores politici debent tollere latrunculos,& noxios seu sceleratos homines.

page.notes: Handwritten marginal annotations on the right ("Bonus", "Leonum") are manuscript and were not transcribed. Edge fragments of the facing page on the left are not printed text of this page. The head "Leo imago boni gubernatoris." is set in larger type and treated as a heading; the level is an estimate.
